about: Stage 3 (multi-exposure printing) and stage 4 (density masks) golden numbers of the CHB-010 intern guide §6.5, §6.6 and §9.2. Setup unless noted: Portra 400 on Portra Endura, TH-KG3 lamp, the database neutral pack, SPEKTRAFILM conventions, D50 viewing, no flare, real mode, aim 'midgray-normalised' (the guide's computations have no aim lights), main exposure 10 s at f/8. Points are 0.025 log H.

entries.note: a one-stop burn at mask 0.5 adds log10(1 + 0.5); a log-domain burn would add 0.5·log10 2
